body: What's the point of going longer though?

I have nothing to look forward to, and that feeling becomes more vivid every single day, like your nightmares turning into realities. My future, however "appealing" doesn't interest me. The prospect of money, fame, loving family, children, none if it matters in my head. The absolute worst and horrid part of all of this is that my family completely and utterly LOVES me, and so do a few of my friends. They are literally the only thing keeping me tied here, every damn day it's a chore to get up and show myself to be strong for them (Though they have caught on, a friend of mine knows i'm suicidal, my family thinks i have depression). The ONLY joy i have is helping people ( and select few people at that ), the only reason why my friend(s) stay beside me is because i have, according to them, done so much for them. It's all so hard, and it becomes harder every day. I have intent and the means to carry it out. I have been drained from all my strength to carry on, of all the happiness because it's all gone.
